finding.required: >= 3% of built-up area (planning minimum ASSUMED_FOR_TEST) = 1,105 m²
finding.clause: G.O.168 rule 15(a)(x) as substituted by G.O.Ms.No.7 of 2016 (group housing of 100 units or more: 'upto 3% of the total built up area (or) 50,000 Sft. whichever is lower', in a block that is not part of the residential blocks)
finding.note: UNRESOLVED_INTERPRETATION: the 3% minimum is the 2012 wording, kept as the planning target and ASSUMED_FOR_TEST. G.O.Ms.No.7 of 2016 rewrote the clause as 'upto 3% of the total built up area (or) 50,000 Sft. whichever is lower', which may make 3% a ceiling and adds a cap. Not settled law: a sanctioned plan of 100 units or more, or the architect, settles how it is read. The amenities block is separate from the residential blocks, as the clause requires.
